description: 8-channel data acquisition unit and logger with RS485 Modbus RTU
source: Samrello, Mapa de registros Modbus, Aquisitor de dados A202, version 1.02 revision 2

sources.title: Mapa de registros Modbus - Aquisitor de dados A202
sources.note: Supplied with the map request; software V1.02 or later

notes: Registers are numbered as in the manual, which is one-based (address_base 1).

Functions: 0x03 and 0x04 read, 0x06 and 0x10 write registers, 0x01, 0x05 and 0x0F reach the on/off registers as coils; this map lists them as holding registers. Report slave ID (0x17) returns 32 ASCII characters.

Values are in engineering units (u.e) with the decimals set in registers 176 to 183, so divide by 10 to the power of the decimal places. Channel status in register 69 reads 00 OK, 01 under range, 10 over range, 11 no reading.
The manual's table 2 (output status, register 66) is cut off in the document; relay 1 is bit 0 and relay 2 the next bit. The relay states are also available as registers 116 and 117.

Serial settings: 9600, 19200, 38400 or 57600 baud; none, odd or even parity; 1 or 2 stop bits; address 1 to 247; 8 data bits. Registers 324 to 326 can only be written while the virtual jumper is active (register 327).

The manual's log memory section (the data file read-out) is not mapped; only the configuration registers of the logger and the real-time clock are listed. Times are BCD, and the 32-bit values are split over four registers, one byte each.
